fact: When removing a diagnostic export, also remove all skip_if_not(exists('export_name')) test blocks in the same commit.
why: Skipped tests become dead code. The removal commit is the right moment.

fact: To exclude dirs from R packages: (1) add to .Rbuildignore, (2) git rm --cached -r for dirs committed before the .gitignore entry.
why: Both steps required — .Rbuildignore for tarball, git rm --cached to stop tracking.

fact: When an estimator calls median selection twice (median + MAD), the crossover threshold does NOT shift. Same threshold applies.
why: Doubling both implementations preserves the ratio.

fact: Cap mclapply workers: min(n_phys-1, floor(avail_mb * 0.80 / worker_mem_mb)). Override via BENCH_MAX_WORKERS.
why: Fixed cap wastes cores on large machines; uncapped crashes small ones.

fact: After removing diagnostic exports, add expect_false(exists('export_name', envir=asNamespace('pkg'))) tests that persist permanently.
why: Unlike skip-guarded tests (removed at cleanup), absence guards enforce the removed state across future sessions.

fact: R function defaults used in identical() fast-path checks must match the full-precision internal constant, not a rounded version.
why: qn()/sn() had 4-digit defaults vs 14-digit internal constants → spurious slow path for canonical values.

fact: Validate input once at C++ entry point. Redundant validate_finite in _impl functions is acceptable (~350ns vs 3.9µs for R-side check).
why: Simplicity outweighs ~2.45µs total redundancy when scale_robust dispatches to 7 estimators.

fact: Cache-dependent thresholds: use algorithmic divisors (NR iteration count), not per-machine tuning. L2 size adapts via runtime detection.
why: Per-machine TBB/prefetch variation <2x; L2 varies 4-8x. Formula captures the dominant variable.
